reader.requirement: The period is the special insertion character and the actual decimal point (counted in the size, aligning the value and appearing in its picture position); V and '.' in one character-string are refused; a '.' that is the last symbol must be immediately followed by the separator period as the entry's last clause; under DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA the comma takes these roles (',.').

edition-consulted.switches: at 1985 a fixed currency symbol takes only the leading role in the precedence chart; the decimal-point and digit roles are the same arm
at 1985 S, V, the decimal point, CR and DB take no repeat factor (§1985:VI.5.9.4 GR7); a single '.' is unaffected
the maximum character-string length of the edition

reader.notes: Every clause of GR5 holds at --std 85: size counting, alignment, position, the V exclusion, the last-symbol separator-period rule (the lexer plus PictureSeparatorPeriodRule, COBOL2419) and the DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA interchange. The edition arms on the path (currency role, repeat factors, string length) do not touch the period's special-insertion role. Diagnostics cite §2023 clauses at --std 85.
